description:
I'm excited to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, where we can use creativity, technology, and scientific data to solve real-world challenges.

I'm looking for enthusiastic and creative team members with skills in AI/ML, Python, Data Science, Web Development, UI/UX Design, Data Visualization, or scientific research. Different perspectives, good communication, teamwork, and a willingness to learn are what I value most.
summary:
MarsWalk is an interactive Mars exploration planning platform designed to support future astronauts during surface exploration missions. Focusing on Jezero Crater, the application brings together different types of planetary science information, including surface imagery, elevation, temperature, mineral composition and rover observations.

The platform provides an interactive map, scientific points of interest, potential terrain hazard indicators and a route planning interface. It aims to help explorers understand the surrounding environment, identify scientifically interesting locations and plan their surface activities more effectively.

By combining information from multiple NASA missions into a unified interface, MarsWalk demonstrates how existing robotic exploration data can support future human missions to Mars. Its primary goal is to make planetary information more accessible, understandable and useful for safer exploration and scientific discovery.
details:
MarsWalk is a web-based Mars surface exploration and safety planning application developed to address the challenges of future human exploration of Mars.

The application focuses on Jezero Crater, a scientifically important region explored by NASA's Perseverance rover. It provides an interactive map interface where users can explore locations, examine scientific information, view different planetary data categories and plan hypothetical surface exploration routes.

The main features include:

• Interactive Mars exploration map with location markers and navigation.
• Scientific data layer controls for optical imagery, elevation, thermal information, mineral composition and rover observations.
• Scientific points of interest with geological information.
• Potential terrain hazard indicators for identifying challenging areas.
• A basic route planner showing suggested exploration paths, estimated distance and travel duration.
• An astronaut safety dashboard displaying terrain risk and environmental information.

The project is designed to bring different types of planetary science information into one accessible interface instead of requiring explorers to consult multiple separate sources.

We use React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Leaflet to develop the web application. The project uses NASA planetary science resources as its scientific foundation, with demonstration and estimated values clearly distinguished wherever actual measurements are unavailable.

MarsWalk demonstrates how existing robotic mission observations can be transformed into a practical exploration-planning interface for future human missions. It aims to support safer decision-making, efficient exploration and new scientific discoveries on the Martian surface.
